stable.label: physical-creature-v1-ci-pass
stable.note: Physical Creature V1 has independent GitHub Actions CI evidence for the causal model tests. The deployed browser module has not yet been successfully exercised, so LIVE_TESTED, DEVICE_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.

physical_creature_v1.representation: 2D point-mass articulated skeleton with projected distance constraints and lumped joint-torque muscle actuators
implemented: eight persistent body nodes with position, velocity, mass, structural integrity, skin integrity, flesh mass, temperature, hydration and damage
six persistent joint records with integrity and angle limits
eight lumped muscle actuators driven by controller activation rather than direct body position/velocity assignment
explicit bounded authored pelvis-height/balance stabilizer exposed in controller state
persistent wounds and localized body/joint/bone integrity damage
scalar blood-volume loss affecting muscle output, consciousness and circulatory death
lung integrity, ventilation and oxygenation proxy affected by torso damage
physical food body with jaw contact, capture and throat approach before stomach inventory
stomach contents, gradual digestion energy release, indigestible mass and waste mass
death from circulatory failure, prolonged hypoxia or energy failure
live inspector exposing body, joint, muscle, feeding and physiology state
approximations: 2D point masses and projected distance constraints; not FEM or a validated biomechanical rigid-body model
muscles are lumped torque/stance actuators; not anatomical fiber/tendon bundles
balance includes an authored PD pelvis-height stabilizer; this is not learned balance
blood is a scalar circulation proxy; not transported fluid
lungs are a ventilation/oxygen state model; not gas-exchange CFD
digestion is a lumped stomach inventory and energy-release model; not biochemical digestion
controller is a hand-authored oscillator/reflex controller; no learning is claimed

prior_failed_run.cause: overly literal documentation grep failed before causal tests; gate repaired and rerun

browser_exercise.detail: Headless Chromium did not return a trustworthy DOM smoke result in the current container because the browser process hung with DBus/zygote errors.

legacy_experimental_stack.note: V100-V110 layered experiments are preserved for reference and do not upgrade this slice's verification.

previous_canonical_state.note: Prior Materials 0.3 canonical record remains recoverable in Git history.

active_objective: Exercise the deployed /genesis-codehood/physical-creature-v1/?smoke=1 browser module in a functioning browser and inspect runtime readiness plus invariants before promoting beyond CI_PASS.
next_gate: LIVE_TESTED requires executing the deployed JavaScript module and inspecting its runtime self-check. A source fetch, Pages HTTP 200, or CI result alone is insufficient. DEVICE_TESTED and VERIFIED remain blocked.
invariants: ROADMAP != IMPLEMENTED != TESTED != CI_PASS != LIVE_TESTED != DEVICE_TESTED != VERIFIED
No visual effect may be called a simulation without authoritative evolving state
No interpolation may be called physics
No authored controller may be called learning
No mutation-only system may be called evolution
The Physical Creature V1 controller may not assign body position or velocity as normal locomotion
Food may not add energy before physical capture, swallowing and stomach digestion
Damage must persist and alter functional output
Unknown or unexercised runtime state remains UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
A failed CI gate remains FAIL until the repaired dedicated gate itself passes
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS
The legacy genesis-codehood stack is experimental and non-canonical
